authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9238.2 *beṭṭa gives Hindi beṭā son and beṭī daughter, with neighboring beṭo/beṭi. Danuwar beta/beti is compared with these gendered child nouns; dental t in the survey is retained as a source or phonetic uncertainty. Exact survey form beta is preserved.
